standard_prerequisites.name: A proper morphism with finite fibres is finite
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Stacks Project, Cohomology of Schemes, Lemma coherent-lemma-proper-finite-fibre-finite-in-neighbourhood (tag 02OH); Morphisms, Lemma morphisms-lemma-image-proper-scheme-closed (tag 01W6)
standard_prerequisites.use: Turns the birational hypothesis into finiteness of f, which is what makes the rest of the computation work.

standard_prerequisites.name: Euler characteristics: additivity, the projection formula, and the finite support lemma
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Stacks Project, Varieties, Lemmas lemma-euler-characteristic-additive (tag 08AA) and lemma-chi-tensor-finite (tag 0AYT); Cohomology, Lemma cohomology-lemma-projection-formula (tag 01E8)
standard_prerequisites.use: Supply the four equalities of the telescoping computation.

core_obligations: Show f is proper and has fibres of dimension at most zero, hence is finite, so that Rf_*f^*E = f_*f^*E = E tensor f_*O_{X'} (proof lines 9622-9631).

Use the hypothesis on the local rings at the generic points of the one-dimensional components to see that the kernel K and cokernel Q of O_X -> f_*O_{X'} have support of dimension at most zero, and note that tensoring the sequence by the locally free E preserves exactness (proof lines 9632-9641).

Telescope the difference chi(X, E) - chi(X', f^*E) through the displayed chain of equalities, using finiteness of f, the projection formula, additivity of Euler characteristics, and the rank linearity of chi on zero-dimensional support (proof lines 9642-9658).
Justify each equality of the chain: the first because f is finite, the second by the projection formula, the third by additivity, and the fourth by the finite-support lemma (proof lines 9659-9665).
proof_roadmap: Upgrade birational to finite using properness and zero-dimensional fibres.
Express the pullback Euler characteristic through f_*O_{X'} by the projection formula.
Bound the support of the kernel and cokernel of O_X -> f_*O_{X'}.
Telescope the Euler characteristics and use rank linearity on zero-dimensional supports.
difficulty_reason: The lemma proves deg(f^*E) = deg(E) for a birational morphism f : X' -> X of proper schemes of dimension at most 1 over a field and a finite locally free E of constant rank, and notes that the hypothesis can be weakened to f inducing a bijection on one-dimensional components and isomorphisms at the corresponding generic points. The proof first shows f is proper with fibres of dimension at most zero, hence finite, so that Rf_*f^*E = E tensor f_*O_{X'} by the projection formula; it then uses the exact sequence 0 -> K -> O_X -> f_*O_{X'} -> Q -> 0 whose kernel and cokernel have zero-dimensional support, and telescopes the difference of Euler characteristics through additivity and the rank-linear behaviour of chi on zero-dimensional support (proof lines 9621-9665). H2: the identification of the kernel and cokernel of O_X -> f_*O_{X'} as zero-dimensional and the Euler characteristic telescoping are the substance.
